USDL-25-0999

THE EMPLOYMENT SITUATION -- MAY 2025

Total nonfarm payroll employment decreased by 33,000 in May, and the unemployment rate rose to 4.3 percent, the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics reported today.

The labor force participation rate, at 62.4 percent, was unchanged over the month.

In May, average hourly earnings for all employees on private nonfarm payrolls rose by 8 cents, or 0.2 percent, to $36.00. Over the past 12 months, average hourly earnings have increased by 3.8 percent.

The change in total nonfarm payroll employment for March was revised down by 10,000, from +150,000 to +140,000, and the change for April was revised down by 25,000, from +175,000 to +150,000. With these revisions, employment in March and April combined is 35,000 lower than previously reported.
